title: feat(w2dbl): cost-2 out-face doubled pairing holds k=1..4
science: Third comparator of the band -- doubled pairing ((2k,0,0),(k,k,k)) with 3 t_axis^2 vs 4 t_body^2 -- under w2 on B_12(0): axis 6,12,18,24; body 5,10,13,16; reverse holds at every available k=1..4. These eight arrivals turn out to be identical under c2d3 (#6975) and c2d4 (#6983) as well, so the doubled comparator, like the same-k one, is blind to the source-max floor.
verdict_pair: reverse=YES at k=1..4 (doubled-pairing bit; NOT a family ver
